source_work: Noah Webster, An American Dictionary of the English Language (1828)
rights_basis: The original 1828 dictionary text is public domain; only its historical definitions and examples are transcribed, not website editorial material.
transcription_source: Internet Archive volume 2 printed page scans and OCR, cross-checked against online Webster transcriptions; original OCR is retained unchanged.
selection_method: Selected the first four exact KJV-used S headwords in alphabetical order from the unreviewed high/medium OCR queue. This is a targeted OCR queue, not a claim that all Webster entries have been reviewed.
review_method: Visually checked all four entries against printed page scans, resolving online transcription errors from the scans. Recovered SHAPE noun senses 3-7 from OCR lines interleaved with other columns, removed neighboring entries and running headers, corrected substitutions and sense numbering, and retained historical examples and author citations. Expanded parts of speech and normalized whitespace and punctuation for display. Source spans are one-based lines in the hash-verified OCR file.
review_scope: All definitions and examples: two SHADY senses; five SHAPE transitive senses, its intransitive sense, and seven noun senses; nine SHARPNESS senses; six ordinary SHEET noun senses, its nautical noun sense, three verb senses, and the sheet home phrase. Readable etymology is retained; the first SHEET noun etymology containing damaged Greek OCR is omitted rather than guessed. This is not a complete etymological review.

entries.review_note: Scan n571 confirms both adjective senses and the Bacon wording for summer and warm for winter; did not add the extra articles found in the online transcription. Retained Dryden and Bacon citations.

Scan n574 confirms all three parts of speech, readable etymology, and seven noun senses. Base import stopped after noun sense 2; restored senses 3-7 from interleaved OCR lines 188871-188898 using the scan's middle column. Excluded intervening SHAPELESS, SHAMOIS, SHARD, and SHAPED material. Kept the source's chapter-only Ps. li. citation rather than the online page's incorrect Psalm 51:1 link.

Scans n575 and n576 confirm the nine senses across the page break, including sharpness of death or calamity where the online transcription drops words. Removed running headers and the merged SHARP-SET entry. Retained Wotton, Watts, Shak., Dryden, and Addison citations.

Scan n578 confirms both noun entries, the verb, and sheet home. Retained the nautical etymology, demi, contain, Mar. Dict. attribution, and Little used labels. Removed SHELDAFLE column contamination and the merged SHEET-ANCHOR entry; omitted the first noun etymology containing uncertain Greek.
